On the Nvidia situation:

Nvidia, $NVDA, is now down another -7% today and -12% since the Jensen Huang affair situation began.

At this point, the market is pricing in two major potential headwinds.

First, the growing possibility that Jensen Huang will be removed as CEO.

Second, possibility that sensitive Nvidia technology or information was compromised.

Are these scenarios possible? Sure, but we believe both remain unlikely, with less than a 20% probability.

Nvidia's stock is now down -32% in just 24 trading days, erasing -$1.8 trillion in market cap, with over one-third of these losses coinciding with the Jensen Huang controversy.

We believe Huang remains an integral part of Nvidia's future and the broader AI Revolution, and this week's events will not derail the broader thesis.

As the dust settles and uncertainty begins to fade, we expect bargain hunters to step in.

The fundamental AI investment thesis remains intact.

posts.text:
Goldman adds third rate hike to forecast

"The October CPI report surprised meaningfully to the upside across several categories and marked a third month of worse inflation news. We continue to expect a second 25bp rate hike in December and are adding a third 25bp hike to our forecast in March 2027. A third hike could come earlier in January, but we think March is a bit more likely because we expect the November and December inflation reports to be softer but then expect larger start-of-the-year price increases amidst ongoing cost pressures to boost inflation in January"

posts.text:
This is the political platform I’d like to see adopted…

“The best defence a nation can build isn’t just miltary hardware. It's becoming an an example.”

Strive to be the ‘shining city on the hill’:

• Abundant, low-cost, clean energy, because cheap power lifts everything else

• Modern infrastructure and agriculture that feed its people and have plenty left to share

• World-class education, the best health care, low crime and the lowest unemployment

• A culture of sharing and harmony at home, so prosperity reaches everyone

Then turn it outward. Be the nation that shows up first with aid, power, food and know-how when others are struggling.

The surest way to end terrorism is to run out of enemies. Make as many friends as possible. Give people hope and a model worth copying, and extremism loses its recruits.

Energy is where it starts. Every leap in living standards in history has been an energy story. The nation that gets cheap, clean energy right gets to lead by example.

Don't tell the world how to do it. Show them.
